audit_metadata.title: ARGUS Clean Class-Aware CORAL MCC Reconciliation Audit

investigation_summary.problem: P1-1 reported Clean Class-Aware CORAL MCC = 0.3855, whereas P2 reported MCC = 0.3904.
investigation_summary.root_cause: The original August 13 package included summary metric tables (final_metrics.csv) but lacked the per-sample prediction CSV. The September audit reproduction script (scratch/v3_v4.py) retrained an XGBoost model on ciciot_train_clean_class_aware_coral.csv to regenerate sample-level probabilities (Clean_Class_Aware_CORAL_preds.npz). Due to multithreaded tree-building non-determinism (n_jobs=-1) during retraining, the retrained model produced slightly different probability calibration, shifting 4,409 benign predictions from False Positive to True Negative (+4,409 TN) and 2,358 attack predictions from True Positive to False Negative (-2,358 TP) at tau=0.99. This altered the confusion matrix slightly and raised the recomputed MCC by +0.004925 (from 0.385503 to 0.390428). Both evaluations used identical test labels, identical positive-class conventions (1=attack), identical thresholds (0.99), and identical MCC formulas.
methodological_conclusions: 2. Test row ordering & ground truth: Verified bit-for-bit identical (N=2,627,177 rows, 72.584% attack).
4. Metric implementation: Verified identical standard Matthews Correlation Coefficient formula.
5. Discrepancy etiology: The 0.0049 discrepancy arose exclusively from retraining stochasticity when reconstructing missing raw test prediction arrays.

6. Journal paper policy: All published tables must cite the authoritative original benchmark MCC = 0.3855 (final_metrics.csv). The secondary 0.3904 must be disclosed in reproducibility footnotes as a retrained replication artifact.
